allowed_binding_corrections.source_only_reason: The new caption explicitly identifies the dogs whose new collars Audrey is showing, resolving the dog-type antecedent in this local exchange. It is supplementary; a picture of two dogs does not determine adoption year or prove there are only two dogs.

The new metadata names Pixie, Pepper, Precious and Panda as dogs while the text distinguishes Pixie from the pre-existing other dogs. This usefully constrains first three versus newly added Pixie; it does not independently establish the earlier adoption date.

The new Japanese-mansion metadata links the planned stay to the accommodation referent. This is material qualifying context for an answer that might otherwise overclaim a purchase or confuse new accommodation with a completed stay; it is not evidence of a sale.

required_group_corrections.reason: D1:18 now itself carries the title in upstream image-search metadata together with the first-watched duration. It satisfies both date and title-identity support. Requiring D1:16 separately would require a redundant citation; retain two semantic groups but admit D1:18 as a title-support alternative.

The upstream exact item identity Ferrari 488 GTB exists in D2:5 metadata, not D2:1. Require that identity evidence as well as mansion and car-acquisition support. D2:5 also asserts finally got myself this beauty with a car caption/identity, so it can satisfy both car groups. Preserve upstream_acquisition_underspecified: neither image search metadata nor new-mansion language independently proves a real estate purchase.

unchanged_rulings: All fourteen changed fact bindings already allowed in the proposal retain useful content and exactly preserve their original raw statement, with a clearly labeled metadata append. They are approved at binding level, along with matching raw episodes.
Only the six additional exact bindings below change from prohibited to allowed. Other appended metadata does not justify blanket promotion of a source population.
Jolene D2:26 image caption mentioning a dog does not prove she owns a dog; its metadata and gaming text do not identify her own pets and remain prohibited for the snake query.
Dancing photos, generic pets/hiking images and other-person movie preferences remain irrelevant to the specific dated events/attributes unless a binding below says otherwise.
limitations: Image-search queries are dataset annotations used to identify intended image referents, not verbatim user assertions or independently inspected images. This reviewer did not fetch/view remote images.
